details.report: Closed the canonical container domain by auditing Reflect.ownKeys: symbol-keyed object/array members now receive typed stable $/<symbol> rejection, arrays reject every non-index own property at its escaped structural path, and all plain-record string own keys participate in canonical serialization. Reflection and getter exceptions remain unwrapped. Added the authorized object-symbol and array-extra alias regressions once and regenerated the shipped artifact. Verified focused canonical tests, typecheck, isolated-HOME full suite (358 pass, 5 skip), package/cold-install coverage within that suite, npm pack --dry-run (111 files), build, and git diff --check. No other PR39 class changed; worktree is clean.
